question: Hari Prasad Chaurasia is a notable exponent of which musical instrument?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Flute**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia:-**

 
 
• **He is an Indian flautist and a prominent figure in the Hindustani classical music tradition. **
 
• Renowned as the "Wizard of the Flute," Chaurasia has captivated audiences worldwide with his mastery of the bansuri, a simple bamboo flute.
 
• Under the tutelage of renowned flautist Bholanath Prasanna of Varanasi, Chaurasia honed his skills for eight years, developing a unique style that blended traditional techniques with his own innovative flair.
 
• Acknowledged for his exceptional contributions to Hindustani classical music, Chaurasia has received numerous accolades from the Government of India.
 
• He was bestowed the Padma Bhushan in 1992 and the Padma Vibhushan in 2000.
 
• His achievements have also earned him prestigious awards such as the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award, Dada Saheb Phalke Award, and Padma Shri.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Veena:-**

 
 
• The veena is the oldest of the three instruments, and it is thought to have been invented over 5,000 years ago.
 
• It is a versatile instrument that can be used to play a wide variety of music, from devotional hymns to folk songs to complex ragas.
 
• **The veena has a large, hollow body that is made of wood or gourd, and it has four main strings that are played with a metal plectrum.**
 
 
 
• **Sitar:-**
 
 
• The sitar is a more recent invention, dating back to the 16th century.
 
• It is a popular instrument in Hindustani classical music, and it is known for its distinctive sound, which is characterized by its use of sympathetic strings.
 
• **The sitar has a long, narrow neck with a gourd resonator at the top, and it has four main strings and up to 20 sympathetic strings.**
 
 
 
• **Sarod:-**
 
 
• The sarod is another popular instrument in Hindustani classical music, and it is known for its rich, deep sound.
 
• **The sarod is similar to the sitar in many ways, but it has a shorter neck and a different tuning. **
 
• **The sarod has four main strings and up to 15 sympathetic strings.**
